cases.evidence: The frozen bootstrap failed before V1 collection while downloading keyring from files.pythonhosted.org. The log records TimeoutError, ReadTimeoutError, and ConnectionError; no project metadata, installed-state, marker, or resolver decision was produced.

causal_checks.explicit_extras: Every completed case reported exactly the extra set bound to its frozen bootstrap SHA256.
causal_checks.project_attribution: All 23 active project requirements were uniquely installed and compatible; no project-closure failure or ambient resolver conflict was observed.
causal_checks.resolver: All four executed direct python -m pip check commands exited zero without timeout after network disconnection.
causal_checks.network_isolation: Every completed V1 artifact reports the host marker and no default route; the host runner reports an empty connected-network set.
causal_checks.poetry: The missing V1 outcome is caused by a pre-collection package-host read timeout and cannot be interpreted as V1 Pass or Fail.

conclusions: Round 12 establishes the first real V1 Pass evidence for four Dev-5 repositories across both PEP 610 and legacy editable provenance.
Poetry requires a preregistered infrastructure-only retry after user-confirmed network change; no V1 policy change is justified.
No nonzero resolver or attributable closure counterexample was observed in real cases, so those branches remain supported only by synthetic tests.
These development results do not establish Official Pass, held-out generalization, or leaderboard improvement.
